# UAE Settlement Calculator

> Free UAE full & final settlement calculator (end-of-service gratuity + unused annual leave encashment + notice-period pay + pending salary), computed per UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021. A Servia Group (servia.ae) project — more Gulf/GCC end-of-service and labour-law calculators at calcnate.com.

## Calculator
- [UAE Full & Final Settlement Calculator](https://uaesettlement.com/): Computes what a departing UAE employee is owed in one figure — end-of-service gratuity (21 days basic salary/year for the first 5 years, 30 days/year after, capped at 2 years' wages, min. 1 year service), unused annual leave encashed at basic wage, notice-period pay in lieu (if the employer ended the contract without notice), plus any pending unpaid salary, minus documented deductions such as loans or advances. Resignation no longer reduces gratuity since Decree-Law 33/2021.

## Guides & articles
- [UAE Full & Final Settlement: The Complete 2026 Guide](https://uaesettlement.com/guide/): What's included in a settlement, how each component is calculated, the 14-day payment deadline, and what to do (MOHRE complaint process) if an employer is late or underpays.
- [UAE Gratuity Law Explained: Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021](https://uaesettlement.com/gratuity-law-2021/): A plain-English breakdown of the law that governs UAE end-of-service gratuity — the 21/30-day formula, the 2-year wage cap, and what changed for employees who resign (resignation no longer reduces gratuity).
- [UAE Notice Period Pay: How Much Are You Owed?](https://uaesettlement.com/notice-period/): How UAE notice-period pay works — the standard 30-90 day contractual range, what happens if an employer ends a contract without giving notice, and how pay in lieu is calculated on gross salary.
- [Domestic Worker Gratuity in the UAE: Maids, Nannies & Drivers](https://uaesettlement.com/domestic-workers-gratuity/): The separate regime for the 19 domestic-worker occupations under Federal Decree-Law No. 9 of 2022 — why the current law contains NO gratuity formula (Article 22 delegates it to the Cabinet; the "14 days per year" figure comes from the repealed Federal Law No. 10 of 2017), what IS clearly owed at end of service (unpaid wages, unused annual-leave cash at last wage, return ticket, 10-day settlement deadline), a domestic-worker vs mainland-employee comparison table, and the MOHRE claim process (AED 50,000 ministry adjudication, court-fee exemption, 3-month time bar).

## Structured data
Every page carries schema.org JSON-LD: WebApplication (the calculator) or Article (the guides), FAQPage with real question/answer pairs matching the on-page content, and BreadcrumbList. A sitemap is at https://uaesettlement.com/sitemap.xml.

## Trust & sourcing
Figures are computed directly from UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 (the UAE Labour Law) and its executive regulations — no invented numbers. This is a free calculator tool, not legal advice; users with a real dispute should confirm with MOHRE or a labour lawyer.

## Calculators & guides added 2026-08-30
- [UAE End of Service Calculator](https://uaesettlement.com/end-of-service-calculator/): Calculate your UAE end-of-service gratuity under Federal Decree-Law 33/2021: 21 days of basic pay per year for the first five years, 30 days per year after, with the two-year cap applied.
- [UAE Leave Salary & Encashment Calculator](https://uaesettlement.com/leave-salary-calculator/): Calculate UAE leave salary and unused annual leave encashment: 30 calendar days a year after one year of service, accrued at 2 days a month between six and twelve months, paid on basic salary.
- [Dubai Gratuity: Mainland, DIFC and Free Zones](https://uaesettlement.com/dubai-gratuity/): How gratuity works in Dubai in 2026. There is no separate Dubai gratuity law — mainland Dubai follows the federal law, while DIFC runs the DEWS scheme and free zones vary. Here is which applies to you.
- [DIFC End of Service & the DEWS Scheme](https://uaesettlement.com/difc-dews/): How end-of-service works in the DIFC: the DEWS workplace savings plan replaced gratuity in 2020, with monthly employer contributions of 5.83% or 8.33% of basic salary held outside the employer.
- [Free Zone Gratuity in the UAE](https://uaesettlement.com/free-zone-gratuity/): How end-of-service gratuity works in UAE free zones. Most follow the federal 21/30 day formula, but DIFC and ADGM run separate savings schemes. Here is how to tell which applies to you.
- [Limited vs Unlimited Contracts After the 2022 Reform](https://uaesettlement.com/limited-vs-unlimited-contract/): Unlimited contracts were abolished in the UAE. All mainland employment is now fixed-term, and the old early-termination penalties that cut gratuity no longer exist. Here is what replaced them.
- [Gratuity After 5 Years: the 21 vs 30 Day Bands](https://uaesettlement.com/gratuity-after-5-years/): What happens to UAE gratuity after five years of service. The 30-day rate applies only to years beyond the fifth — it does not retroactively upgrade your first five years. Worked examples included.
- [Unpaid Salary or Gratuity: How to Complain to MOHRE](https://uaesettlement.com/unpaid-salary-complaint/): Step-by-step guide to filing a UAE labour complaint when an employer will not pay your salary, gratuity or final settlement — the MOHRE process, evidence to gather, and what happens next.
- [UAE Unemployment Insurance (ILOE) Explained](https://uaesettlement.com/unemployment-insurance-iloe/): How the UAE's ILOE unemployment insurance scheme works: who must subscribe, the two premium categories, the 60% of basic salary benefit, the three-month limit and how to claim.
- [Arbitrary Dismissal Compensation in the UAE](https://uaesettlement.com/arbitrary-dismissal-compensation/): What counts as arbitrary or unlawful dismissal under UAE labour law, the compensation of up to three months' wages, and how it sits alongside gratuity and notice pay.
